card.architecture: BiRefNet per-frame matte (BiRefNetMatte node, ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet via transformers) — LoadVideo → GetVideoComponents → BiRefNetMatte → SaveAnimatedWEBP(lossless, alpha)
card.summary: Removes the background from every frame of a source clip with BiRefNet and outputs a transparent-background animated WEBP (lossless, so the alpha channel survives). No checkpoint — the node loads its own model. Chosen as the sprite pipeline's background-removal method over a flood-fill key and the other matting models.
use_cases: cut a character clip out of its (white) background into a transparent sprite clip
background removal for the sprite export pipeline
card.pick_when: You have a video clip and want its background removed (transparent alpha).
